sermon.title: Water Baptism and Confession
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this short message on Bible morality the speaker says forgiveness of sin has four parts: repent, be water baptized, confess that Jesus and the Bible are true, and believe. He ties baptism to Romans 6 and Colossians 2, uses Romans 10:9, 1 John 1:9 and the burned books of Acts 19, and closes with a prayer for becoming a Christian.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. The recording does not state the speaker’s name; the “Bible morality” theme matches Pastor Kincer’s other messages, but his name is not spoken, so Michael should confirm. Editor notes: he cites “Colossians” without a chapter (the passage is Colossians 2:11–13), and the captions read “haven’t forgiven you” where Colossians 2:13 reads “having forgiven you”; he reads John 3:16 and continues into the verses after it (John 3:18–20); “Psalms 119 verse 1 51” is Psalm 119:151. This message includes strong opinions on sexual morality, religious groups (including Judaism, Islam, Catholicism, the Amish and Protestants), and “wimps” and “bullies”; these are his own views and are not endorsed or verified here.
